reason: The studio's category union and server allowlist had no way to express or display a 'friction' kind, so a valid artifact was unrepresentable and rejected.
The shipped contract-coverage script parses .tsx sources as ScriptKind.TS, returning the same understated count to every caller.
The ADR-NNNN placeholder namespace cannot distinguish a session's pending allocation from the corpus's generic any-ADR pattern token, so substitution could not be scoped correctly.
The existing build verb adopts and then terminates the launching session's presence declaration — a wrong write that hits every session using node/story build --real.
The spawned builders ended their turn before the objective was achieved, waiting on a notification that would never come.
Launching without the tsx loader yields a 500 whose message names a workspace package rather than the missing loader — a misleading failure any caller of bare vite gets.
The declared proof command exits 0 on 'No projects matched', so the shipped CONFIRM_RED gate halts with a verdict that misnames the cause for every new-package story.
The .strict() wire schema cannot express an additive producer field, and the surface behind it silently drops every event it cannot parse.
No mechanism exists to detect that a brief's negative-existence premise has been overtaken by a concurrent sibling, so the staleness could only be caught by hand.
The shipped check:coverage credits a contract from a matching test title, so every multi-clause contract reads N/N for every caller regardless of unasserted clauses.
The gate orders its cheap ten-second claim check after typecheck and the full test run, making a trivially fixable red cost an entire re-run for anyone.
The shipped check:mirror-conformance registers only one mirror, so it returns a clean verdict on drifted routes to every caller.
No claim, mutex or conflict check exists for the friction queue at all, so concurrent adjudicators cannot be refused or warned.
check:corpus-content's V=0 ceiling is per-repo rather than per-author, so the shipped rung reds the wrong session for a sibling's live edit.
An existing verb leaves the house @path convention unresolved and overwrites the record wholesale, destroying the prior verdict while reporting success.
The install verb registers an absolute path without checking the host script exists or is post-flip, so it reports an installed wall that enforces nothing.
Node/pnpm/tsx resolve module format and workspace specifiers from the script's own directory, so a scratchpad-resident script fails on platform resolution rules rather than repo code.
The composed sheet and delivered PNG dir have no per-cell field for the code state that produced them, so a two-variable comparison is indistinguishable from a one-variable one.
renderArcRollup fixes parked work last, so the shipped render hides the actionable section behind history for every reader of a mature arc.
The --real build's 16-turn AUTHOR_TEST ceiling is a bad budget that exhausted twice on a two-file unit that a scoped worker proved immediately.
The probe's own stable-picture predicate ran but measured only accretion, so it validated against the wrong condition and admitted visually changing frames.
The authoring session published a directive comparative that was checkable against two artifacts already in the store and simply never checked it.
The lifecycle rule reads only the increment log, a record set that cannot see chip-carried work, so the arc auto-closed with its end state unmet.
The shipped check reports the routine 'stale' signature while holding the fact that regeneration would breach the budget, giving every caller a verdict whose documented remedy is wrong.
No edge, tag or gate rung exists that can detect a later infrastructure ADR semantically falsifying an earlier ADR's prescribed build address.
gate:bg's detach is only effective when nothing holds stdout open, so the existing launcher silently dies under the natural pipe invocation.
The pass's own verify.py check ran but encoded the promise as a branch-diff question, so it validated against the wrong subject and reported a broken promise that did not exist.
No kind-agnostic or field-agnostic corpus text search exists, so the absence sweep the task required could not be performed at all.
The shipped capture harness's non-vacuity guard counts opaque pixels over already-opaque ground, so it returns the same false 'palette closed' verdict to every caller.
The repository's own test fixture teardown races on rmdir, producing a wrong red for branches that touch nothing near it.
capture.mjs hardcodes a steady-state 30s goto budget with no override, a bad default that refuses every first run and misattributes the cause to the page.
The machine's PATH omits an installed Bun, so the gate reds on green code for purely environmental reasons.
The uat run path passes its observe runner raw where adopt memoizes it, so the existing verb re-runs the identical deterministic suite once per leg for every caller.
A shipped probe observes a retired invariant and FAILs a correctly-provisioned box while printing a remedy the onboarding guide forbids.
The shipped rerun comparison asserts 'nothing was fixed' from git state alone, returning a confidently wrong flake verdict for every store-reading rung.
The agent's own measurement instrument ran with arguments in the wrong slots and published plausible numbers, a check that executed while measuring the wrong thing.
The rung's shipped closing message names only two remedies and omits the correct third, steering every session it reds toward a test that cannot be written or a false equivalence marker.
The measurement driver defaults its committed-rung URL to an asset that is not in the repo, so the published reproduce command 404s for every fresh checkout.
The shipped rung reds on any fresh worktree irrespective of branch content and fails to take its documented skip branch, so no such session can gate green.
A flag interaction re-arms a fence the documented --discharged-by exemption should disable, and the refusal prescribes minting a second increment for landed work.
